recreation_brief: 1. Create a new PowerPoint slide with a light gray background (#e8e8e8). 2. Add a thin dark red border (#a00000) around the slide edge. 3. Insert a centered text box near the top-middle with the text 'Solved Example' in red serif font (#c00000), bold, large size. 4. Insert a centered text box below the title with '[ Update Weights of Output Layer and Hidden Layer ]' in blue serif font (#0000cc). 5. Insert another centered text box below that with 'Using one training sample' in blue serif font (#0000cc). 6. Add a yellow circle (#ffd966) in the top-right corner containing the number '26' in black text. 7. Ensure all text is center-aligned horizontally.
